note: Exported by `bash run.sh export`; parity verified against PyTorch (max|d| 4.77e-07 restorer, 2.05e-05 crnn at W=320, 1.29e+00 encoder int8, 8.94e-08 head fp32). crnn.onnx width is FIXED because aten::lstm cannot export with a dynamic sequence length, and it is set to the TRAINING CLAMP realdata.MAX_W = 320 -- not to a value merely below it. It was 256 for a while on the belief that 256 sat above the median crop; the median crop width IS the clamp (98.8% of held-out crops exceed 256px), so the app truncated the tail off nearly every line before the model saw it: on 200 held-out crops exact line match was 44.7% at natural width against 0.0% cut to 256, with the read changed on 200 of 200. Padding is NOT inert either -- the CRNN carries a 2-layer BIDIRECTIONAL LSTM whose backward pass starts at the RIGHT EDGE, i.e. inside the padding, so padded zeros move the hidden states across the VALID frames (measured max |delta| 9.10 at content width 64, 15.28 at 200). app/js/recognizer.js therefore still trims the decode to the crop's true timestep count, ceil(width/8).
